Criterion 1 (corroboration) - nothing in lib/ schedules frames.
Commit: 490ce23

### Frame/ticker/vsync scheduling APIs across lib/ (generated files excluded)
$ grep -rnE 'addPersistentFrameCallback|addPostFrameCallback|scheduleFrame|addTimingsCallback|SchedulerBinding|Ticker|vsync|AnimationController' lib/
(no matches)

### Every Timer in lib/
$ grep -rn 'Timer' lib/ | grep -v generated
lib/core/utils/debouncer.dart:30:  Timer? _timer;
lib/core/utils/debouncer.dart:38:    _timer = Timer(_duration, callback);

-> The only timer is the one-shot in core/utils/debouncer.dart. There is no
   AnimationController, no Ticker, no frame callback and no Timer.periodic.
   The app tree cannot be what keeps frames scheduled.
